title: Let Hukam end the private cross-examination
subtitle: For acceptance that keeps turning grace into another argument
description: This path begins where doubt reopens the received moment. The Hukam lines say nothing stands outside the Command; the readings train the heart to answer uncertainty with humility, truthful repair, and one obedient next step.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Nothing stands outside Hukam; when the heart sees that, doubt loses its right to keep prosecuting the moment.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Name the fact you have received, stop rehearsing the countercase, and choose one truthful action inside it.

evidence.coreClaim: This path protects acceptance by making the Hukam verses answer the mind's courtroom.
evidence.turn: Doubt weakens when the heart receives what is given before ego turns it into a trial.
evidence.practicalImplication: Say what is true about the situation, close the countercase, and act inside Hukam rather than reopening the whole argument.
